landing.tagline: AI Chief of Staff for small teams
landing.subtitle: The operations layer your team needs. Decisions, priorities, and execution — powered by AI, built for teams of 2–20.

chat.title: AI chat with workspace context
chat.description: Ask about priorities, plans, or risks. Answers are grounded in your team's activity and connected Google Calendar/Gmail signals, not generic advice.

decisions.title: Decision support
decisions.description: Log a decision, get a structured recommendation, and track the outcome afterward so the next decision gets sharper.

actions.title: Prepared actions
actions.description: Review AI-drafted next steps in a queue and approve or dismiss them — nothing happens on your behalf without a click.

brief.title: Morning brief
brief.description: A short daily summary of what changed and what needs attention, built from your workspace's real activity.

pulse.title: Company Pulse
pulse.description: A live engagement score across conversations, response time, and team coverage, with the contributing factors shown.

team.title: Team collaboration
team.description: Invite your team with role-based access. Everyone works from the same workspace context.
